articles.title: Roguelike deckbuilder Mechborn announced for Nintendo Switch 2, Switch
articles.description: Curve Games and Turtle Juice have today unveiled Mechborn, which will be released on both Nintendo Switch 2 and Switch. The project will debut in late 2026. Mechborn is a roguelike deckbuilder. In light of a Kaiju assault, players will need to protect Earth and her colonies.
